name: LQS - Booking: offer slots
description: In: conversation_id, agent_id. Out: { ok, booking_id, slots } or { ok:false, error:'no_slots' }. Reads the agent calendar, filters to market working hours in market time, picks three slots on different days, renders labels in the lead timezone and writes the bookings row.

parameters.query: select c.id as conversation_id, c.lead_id as lead_id, l.timezone as lead_tz, l.full_name as lead_name, m.timezone as market_tz, m.working_hours as working_hours, m.min_notice_hours as min_notice_hours, m.booking_window_days as booking_window_days, a.id as agent_id, a.calendar_id as calendar_id, a.timezone as agent_tz, a.full_name as agent_name from lqs.conversations c join lqs.markets m on m.id = c.market_id join lqs.leads l on l.id = c.lead_id cross join lateral (select ag.* from lqs.agents ag where ag.active and ag.market_id = c.market_id and (nullif($2, '') is null or ag.id = nullif($2, '')::uuid) order by ag.created_at limit 1) a where c.id = $1::uuid;
insert into lqs.bookings (conversation_id, lead_id, agent_id, status, offered_slots) values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, 'offered', $4::jsonb) returning id as booking_id;
insert into lqs.bookings (conversation_id, lead_id, agent_id, status, offered_slots) values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, 'no_slots', '[]'::jsonb) returning id as booking_id;
